alternate_titles: Comunicato: In merito ad alcuni articoli riguardanti il Terzo Segreto di Fatima
work.author: Holy See Press Office
work.description: The Holy See Press Office bulletin communique of 21 May 2016 in which Pope emeritus Benedict XVI declares never to have spoken with Professor Ingo Dollinger about Fatima, calls the remarks attributed to Dollinger pure inventions, and confirms that the publication of the Third Secret of Fatima is complete.
work.title: Communique on articles regarding the Third Secret of Fatima
